rows.next_step: Synthesize evidence on Bayesian constraint handling and cognitive flow to assess potential for cross-turn accountability.
rows.question: How can durable state and mechanical constraints enable fresh model invocations to function as a singular, accountable process?
rows.reason: The objective requires reconciling independent, stateless invocations with a durable, verifiable history. Existing evidence on handling global constraints (source-68e294ecf9e64b50) and context-aware flow (source-ac8f7017b6e44a91) provides a starting point for assessing this feasibility.
rows.title: Accountable Cross-Turn State Continuity
